description: Unit tests for the ConnectJob class in the net/socket module, testing connection success, timeout behavior, and priority changes.

classes.name: TestConnectJob
classes.description: A subclass of ConnectJob used for testing different connection scenarios (sync success, async success, hung).

classes.name: ConnectJobTest
classes.description: Test fixture for testing ConnectJob behaviors, including timeouts and priority changes.

methods.name: TestConnectJob::ConnectInternal
methods.description: Overrides the internal connect logic to simulate connection based on job type.

methods.name: TestConnectJob::ChangePriorityInternal
methods.description: Records the priority change for verification.

methods.name: ConnectJobTest::NoTimeoutOnSyncCompletion
methods.description: Tests that synchronous connect completes without timing out.

methods.name: ConnectJobTest::NoTimeoutOnAsyncCompletion
methods.description: Tests that asynchronous connect completes without timing out.

methods.name: ConnectJobTest::NoTimeoutWithNoTimeDelta
methods.description: Ensures no timeout occurs when zero time delta is used.

methods.name: ConnectJobTest::SetPriority
methods.description: Verifies that changing priority updates internal state correctly.

methods.name: ConnectJobTest::TimedOut
methods.description: Checks that a hung connection times out after the specified duration.

methods.name: ConnectJobTest::TimedOutWithRestartedTimer
methods.description: Verifies that resetting the timer affects timeout behavior.
